title: Israeli forces kill four in Gaza as fifth Palestinian dies of wounds
detail: Per Al Jazeera, Israeli forces killed four Palestinians in Gaza on November 3, 2026 and a fifth died of earlier wounds, amid near-daily Israeli fire despite the ceasefire in effect since October 2025. Gaza Health Ministry tallies of ceasefire-period deaths rose from 1,580 (Oct 31) to about 1,593 around Nov 3. Israel says it targets militants and accuses Hamas of violations; Hamas denies this.

media.caption: Israeli forces kill four in Gaza
